user_scope: No full-market bulk download required; discover from dated limited original-report cohort, then use public search/collectors to qualify selected securities
entry: Next verified session open after information cutoff; no current receipt time backdating claim
exit: Open of the next verified session after63 holding sessions
stock_selection: Dated source-backed falsifiable operating thesis; no forced buy. Data mismatch or missing relevant actions blocks that name, not unrelated qualified names.
A_B_C: Same fixed eligible cohort/facts/cost/risk; A company thesis, B adds known macro/catalysts, C relative alternatives, preserve every prior decision
benchmark: KOSPI price index, plus entry-exposure-matched KOSPI/cash gross control; not TR or ETF
control: Single equal-weight buy/hold/sell of all qualified cohort names, capped20% per name and same initial capital/costs; diagnostic control independent of LLM selection
source_qualification: Original DART listing identity and disclosed actions, dated corroborating ticker evidence, two-source raw-price consistency, explicit unresolved limitations. Whole-market PIT completeness not asserted.
corporate_actions: No zero-imputation of missing dividends; issuer original declaration/annual statement and action register required for held names. Read future source for accounting audit only, never pass its operating performance into research.
cutoff_reason: Both Nov30 market closes are public; next KR open Dec1 00Z is still after cutoff. Never expose US Nov30 closing data to an earlier KR cutoff.

costs.scope: Historical experiment assumptions only, not real broker cost measurement; no operating config changes
